parse_asf_skeleton: parse an ASF skeleton file and extract joint data including direction, length, axis, and hierarchy
parse_amc_motion: parse an AMC motion file with joint degrees and return a Motion object with pose data
load_asfamc_data: load ASF skeleton and AMC motion data from files into a Motion or Skeleton object
set_rotation_joints: set rotation matrices on joints using Euler-to-rotation conversion and propagate to child joints
read_line_stream: read and split a line from a text stream at a given index and advance the index
